selected_script.angle: Absurd adult family rescuer saving overstuffed luggage with cordless vacuum bag pump
selected_script.hook: Struggling to zip an overflowing suitcase with clothes bulging out everywhere

script_record.pain_point: Suitcase won't close due to bulky winter clothes taking up 80% of carry-on space
script_record.conflict_hook: Woman desperately jumping on a bulging suitcase in a messy bedroom
script_record.product_solution: Transparent honeycomb grid compression bag sealed with double dark grey zipper and white rechargeable cylindrical air pump auto-shrinking bulky clothes

timeline.scene: Close-up on a swollen suitcase in a bedroom, zip getting stuck and popping open under pressure.

timeline.purpose: 荒诞成年亲属携产品入场
timeline.scene: An absurdly dressed grandma in a shiny sequin tracksuit swoops in carrying the white cylindrical pump and compression bags, shouting 'Move aside honey!'

Grandma quickly places winter coats into the clear honeycomb grid compression bag, zips double track, places white air pump on dark grey valve, and presses the single grey button. Clothes instantly shrink by 80%.
The neatly flattened vacuum bag fits effortlessly into the bottom half of the carry-on luggage.
Demonstrating packing 15 compression bags into a single carry-on suitcase for a business trip.
Organizing home closet shelf with moisture-proof, tear-resistant vacuum bags sealed tight.
Text on screen: 'Save 80% luggage space today! Check it out now.'

script_record.cta: Save 80% luggage space today! Check it out now.
